'''Glowshroom''' was a type of [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. They were considered fragile<ref name="Dantooine" /> and earthy. Glowshrooms can be [[Color/Legends|colored]] green, yellow, or purple.<ref name="Stew" />

==Behind the scenes==
Glowshroom was one of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] that players had to find on Dantooine to receive the "Dantoonian Culinarian" achievement.<ref name="Dantooine" />
